changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ts_submission DROP CONSTRAINT ck_ts_submission_status_result; ALTER TABLE ts_submission ADD CONSTRAINT ck_ts_submission_status_result CHECK ( (status IN ('QUEUED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND grading_result IS NULL AND grading_verdict_id IS NULL AND grading_error_description IS NULL) OR (status = 'GRADED' AND grading_result IS NOT NULL AND ( (grading_result = 'SUCCESS' AND grading_verdict_id IS NOT NULL AND grading_error_description IS NULL) OR (grading_result = 'GRADING_ERROR' AND grading_verdict_id IS NULL AND grading_error_description IS NOT NULL) OR (grading_result = 'TIMEOUT' AND grading_verdict_id IS NULL AND grading_error_description IS NULL) OR (grading_result = 'INVALID_SUBMISSION' AND grading_verdict_id IS NULL AND grading_error_description IS NOT NULL))) );
